checks.name: hover on a function written over two lines shows it as written
hover on a static method names it Owner::name, its head as written
hover on a method called on a value names it Owner.name, its return type said when none is written
hover on a method a trait's implementation declares marks it trait
hover on a function written with no return type says it returns void
hover on a method a private: section holds shows it private
hover on a method written with no visibility in no section shows none
hover on a field names it Owner.field
hover on a struct shows its size, its head and its fields, not its methods
the expanded hover on a struct adds its methods
hover on an enum shows its size, its head and its variants
hover on a generic struct shows no layout, which only its instances have
hover on a type argument in a path's type arguments names the type
hover on a type argument a call is written with names the type
import completion offers the standard library's modules nothing imports
import completion leaves out an internal module nothing imports
document symbols keep each name inside its declaration's range after an edit
